chunks: Sleeping in the early morning is a misfortune: it deprives one of sustenance and pales the complexion. The manna and the quails used to descend upon the Children of Israel between the rising of dawn and the rising of the sun, so whoever slept during that hour, his share would not descend. Then when he awoke and did not see his share, he became in need of asking and seeking.

key_terms.الرِّزْقَ: sustenance and provision granted by Allah
key_terms.السُّؤَالِ وَالطَّلَبِ: asking and seeking from others due to need
key_terms.الْمَنُّ وَالسَّلْوَى: the manna and quails sent as provision to Banī Isrāʾīl
key_terms.شُؤْمٌ: a sign of misfortune or ill effect
key_terms.نَوْمُ الْغَدَاةِ: sleeping in the early morning after dawn

ai.seo_question: Why is sleeping after fajr considered disliked in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith discourages sleeping in the early morning after dawn, describing it as a cause of deprivation in sustenance and weakness in appearance. It also cites the example of Bani Isra'il, whose provision descended in that time, to emphasize the blessing of being awake during the hours between fajr and sunrise.
